data.title: Trio Industrial Electronics in Possible Change-of-Control Deal With Luxshare Unit
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Trio Industrial Electronics Group Limited ( (HK:1710) ).

Trio Industrial Electronics Group Limited has disclosed that Luxshare Precision Limited and Trio Industrial Electronics Holding Limited have signed a non-legally binding memorandum of understanding for a potential sale of 75% of the company’s issued share capital. The MOU grants Luxshare an exclusivity period of two months for negotiations and due diligence, and, if a definitive agreement is reached and completed, the transaction would result in a change of control and trigger a mandatory general offer under Hong Kong’s Takeovers Code.

The potential buyer is a Hong Kong-incorporated subsidiary of Luxshare Precision Industry Co., Ltd., a Shenzhen and Hong Kong-listed electronics group active in consumer, auto and communication sectors. Luxshare and its controlling shareholders are independent third parties to Trio, meaning the possible deal could introduce a new strategic owner from a larger electronics conglomerate, with implications for Trio’s future positioning and governance once control shifts, if the transaction proceeds.

data.title: Moon Inc. Refreshes Board with Appointment of Veteran Hong Kong Politician as Independent Director
data.description:
HK Asia Holdings Limited ( (HK:1723) ) has provided an update.

Moon Inc. has announced changes to its board, with independent non‑executive director Chen Xiaobing resigning effective 2 October 2026 due to personal career commitments. The company noted that Chen has no disagreements with the board and expressed gratitude for his contributions, while confirming his departure from the Nomination Committee.

The board has appointed prominent Hong Kong politician and public figure Shiu Ka Fai, BBS, JP as an independent non‑executive director and member of the Nomination Committee from the same date. Shiu’s extensive legislative and public service experience, along with his confirmed independence under Hong Kong listing rules, is expected to strengthen Moon Inc.’s governance and potentially enhance its positioning with regulators and stakeholders.
